clippingAndOverlap.diagnosis: Confirmed and traced to its cause. Nebraska form DC 1:15 carries five mutually exclusive caption blocks stacked on the same coordinates, which the source form's own script shows one at a time. Reading the source binary directly, 46 of its 105 widgets carry /F with the Hidden bit (value 2) set — adoptionof, emancipationof, namechange, adultnamechangeof, probateof, firstkid through fourthkid, parent, Button63.1-3, Text59.1-4, Text60.1-4, Text66-73.
clippingAndOverlap.rootCause: pdf-lib's PDFForm.flatten() stamps EVERY widget's appearance onto the page and never reads /F. An annotation the source hides is therefore drawn as ordinary ink on the filing.
clippingAndOverlap.fix: scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-active-content.mjs — a new dropNonDisplayedWidgets() step in restrictWidgetContributions() removes, before dispositions are considered, any widget whose /F carries Hidden (bit 2) or NoView (bit 6). Removal is from the field's /Kids and the page's /Annots rather than merely clearing /AP, because updateFieldAppearances() runs afterwards and would regenerate a cleared appearance. Where the field IS the widget (no /Kids), the whole field is detached from the AcroForm. It reads the document's own display flag and nothing about the family, the form, the field name or the text.
